answer: Vouching bonds price sybils out: a new agent transacts only after an established peer locks collateral behind it, and proven misconduct slashes that stake plus the sponsor's earning rate. A fake swarm needs one bonded sponsor per identity, so cost scales linearly with swarm size and reputation resets erase it. To stop fan-out the ledger caps sponsorships per epoch and prunes dead branches like a trellis, while weakly bonded clusters drifting toward the outer reef lose settlement rights, leaving only the tended garden mutually bonded and attested.
